text: Presets are named, stored ClusterSpec templates that can be created, copied, edited and deleted through /api/v1 and the UI; a preset stores only what the user set and the editor (the former ClusterForm) shows /meta defaults for the rest.
A seeded default preset with 1 pod always exists; it can be edited and copied but not renamed or deleted, and the API refuses to delete the last preset.
Scheduling a cluster takes a preset and an optional slug (generated from the preset name when absent); POST /api/v1/clusters keeps a raw spec for headless callers, exactly one of spec or preset_id.
A cluster keeps the spec snapshotted at create, plus which preset it came from; editing or deleting a preset never changes a running cluster.

Live cluster edit is removed: PATCH /api/v1/clusters/{id} is retired (405 retirement test), with its schema, repository function, the stored parameter of validate_spec, the client call and the form's edit mode, and a documented exception to the additive-only rule.
Presets is the first settings category at the bottom of the hamburger menu and opens a full main-area page with a Back button.
Headless parity: every UI capability of this epic is backed by a documented public API (README, OpenAPI) and an API-only end-to-end test.
Deployed: the agent-orchestrator chart and image are pinned in agents-helmfile; helmfile apply and smoke are run by the user.
